reason: Correctly identifies four real defects (mutable default seen=[], missing limit/len bounds check causing IndexError, ZeroDivisionError on empty input, and in-place sort side effect) with accurate causes and examples, but misses the subtler logic bug where fixed-range iteration over `range(0, limit)` combined with the `seen` dedup check can yield fewer than `limit` unique results even when enough distinct scores exist further down the sorted list.
